issue.title: Register class for reflection when returning Multi for JAX-RS Resource
issue.body:
This is needed because we now support passing annotations the MessageBodyWriter classes when streaming is in play

Fixes: #32886

P.S. I didn't add any tests because I was not able to reproduce the problem with out testsuite. However I did verify that the
fix addressed the original Quarkus QE issue
